title: Wordle
description: The Wordle plugin is based on the Wordle browser game and repeats its features.
body:
**Wordle for Minecraft is an exciting plugin that adds the popular Wordle game directly to your Minecraft server! Players can guess words by getting a color indication of the correct letters, just like in the original game.**

**Main features**

Full implementation of Wordle mechanics in Minecraft
Multi-language support (Russian, English, Chinese)
Color indication of letters in the chat
Statistics system for each player
Daily word update
Leaderboard
Customizable rewards for winning

**How to play**

Log in to the server
Write /wordle to start the game
Guess the word by entering it into the chat
Get a color indication:
Green - the letter is in the right place.
Yellow - the letter is in the word, but in a different place.
Gray - there is no letter in the word.
You have 6 attempts to guess the word!

**Customization**

Easy configuration via the configuration file
The ability to add your own words
Setting up rewards for winning
Choosing the language of the game
